description: This file defines structures, types, and functions for managing glyphs in the FreeType library, including glyph extraction, copying, transformation, bounding box calculation, and conversion to bitmap.

classes.name: FT_Glyph
classes.description: Handle to a generic glyph object that can contain bitmap or outline data.

classes.name: FT_BitmapGlyph
classes.description: Subclass of FT_Glyph for bitmap glyph images.

classes.name: FT_OutlineGlyph
classes.description: Subclass of FT_Glyph for outline (vector) glyph images.

methods.name: FT_Get_Glyph
methods.description: Extracts a glyph image from a glyph slot.

methods.name: FT_Glyph_Copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of a glyph image.

methods.name: FT_Glyph_Transform
methods.description: Transforms a scalable glyph image using a matrix and delta.

methods.name: FT_Glyph_Get_CBox
methods.description: Returns the control box (enclosing all points) of a glyph.

methods.name: FT_Glyph_To_Bitmap
methods.description: Converts a glyph to a bitmap glyph.

methods.name: FT_Done_Glyph
methods.description: Releases resources associated with a glyph.

methods.name: FT_Matrix_Multiply
methods.description: Performs matrix multiplication on transformation matrices.
